title: Quest Race
description: A live class race across a 3D island. Answer the questions on your device: every right answer is a gem and a dash towards the finish flag. Played alone, it is a practice race against three ghost runners.
notes: Oomba Live reference game (built-in mode 'quest-race'), on the Oomba Kit 1.1.0 with the dress, bridge-3d and live packs, and the pinned Three.js import map. Game logic and the 2D view are in a classic script (<meta name="oomba-live" content="2d">); the module adds the 3D view. Uses Oomba.live: ready({presence, lobby, quiz, hostView}), the question / reveal / result / race / end events, quiz.answer, move (lobby), crowd (3D) and flat (2D). Test hooks: window.__brbTest.state(), walk(x, y, ms), answer(i).
